Role-Based Authorization

Being logged in and being allowed to do this are two different questions — authorize.js answers the second one.

  • An Allow-List Middleware Factory

    authorize('agent', 'admin') — the same 'a function that returns middleware' shape as validate.js, applied to roles instead of schemas.

  • Applying authorize Per Route

    Who's allowed to create a ticket is a different question from who's allowed to change one — the routes say so directly.
